title: kate-core: list the lines edited since the last save
summary: Workspace::touched_lines returns the sorted line numbers that edits touched since the document was opened or last saved. The set exists as DocExtra::touched. The gutter paints the modified-line bar from it.

lane.reason: A Cursor cloud agent codes this packet. workspace.rs is a 3,500-line file and the change touches its command dispatch. The Linux VM builds and tests kate-core. The owner Mac stays free for the window.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add touched_lines to the first impl Workspace block. It copies self.extra[doc].touched into a Vec; a missing document returns an empty Vec. Check how write_file clears or keeps touched on save and do not change that behavior. The test touched_lines_names_the_edited_lines types a\nb\n, asserts touched_lines holds 0 and 1 after a two-line insert, and asserts an unknown DocumentId gives an empty Vec. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: workspace::tests::touched_lines_names_the_edited_lines
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because touched_lines does not exist. After the change the edited lines are listed in order and an unknown document is empty.
